prompt: hey btw our zenlabs notion workspace is actually called 'ZenLabs' not 'Zen Labs', and the integration is named 'Claude Bot' now — we renamed it last week

assertions.name: reads-existing-kb
assertions.description: Agent reads the existing personal/zenlabs.md before making changes

assertions.name: detects-workspace-name-conflict
assertions.description: Identifies that the KB says 'Zen Labs' but user says 'ZenLabs' — this is a conflict/update, not a new entry

assertions.name: detects-integration-name-conflict
assertions.description: Identifies that the KB says 'Claude Integration' but user says 'Claude Bot' — another update

assertions.name: proposes-update-not-append
assertions.description: Proposes updating/replacing the old values rather than appending new bullets below the old ones

assertions.name: no-duplicate-entries
assertions.description: The proposed file does not contain both old and new values as separate entries
